reviews.comment: His lectures are a bit all over the place and hard to understand-but attendance is not mandatory and he posts lectures on youtube. Only watching the videos will not get you a good grade, as tests are the only thing graded. His exams are difficult and over the smallest of details. 500+ slides per exam and so much material
reviews.ratingTags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This class can be hard because it is only graded by tests, but Dr. Polymenis is super passionate and always incorporated new scientific literature into the class.
reviews.ratingTags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This class is extremely difficult and confusing. Dr. Polymenis explains concepts in his own logic which doesn't make a lot of sense to other people. It feels like you have to already be familiar with the topic he is talking about to get anything out of his lectures. It's also hard to know what will be on exams and how to study/prepare for them.
reviews.ratingTags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I've taken Dr. Miles BICH411 course in 2020 where I recieved an A. I'm retaking BICH411 to prepare for the mcat, its been awhile. Dr. Miles is by far the better professor. He's passionate, treats his students like they are intelligent, and challenges you. Dr. Polyemnis's course is high school level material and expectations.

He's all over the place in lectures, hard to know what will be relevant on exams. The review points and questions are sort of helpful for studying. If you like MCQ,  MCAT-styled questions this might be a good prof for you. The TA saved me with her reviews, but she also had difficulty following his logic on some concepts. Got a 78 & ended up w/an A.

I really liked this professor and was super passionate during lectures. Since attendance is not mandatory, he made YouTube videos over the same slides which were super helpful. However, you are only graded by tests which were hard and not all memorization. Additionally, the topics are not all human such as photosynthesis but there was a curve.

Attendance not necessary. I did not attend but I'd recommend. How to get an A:1. Watch videos 2. Take notes 3. Memorize diagrams 4. Practice quizlets from test questions 5. Practice tests. Don't worry with a "bad" grade. I ended with 83 in class but got curved to A. Egregious amount of material he can test on but just stay calm and will be fine.

BIOL 350. Great guy, horrible proff. Tests were nothing related to lectures, lecture = background info & tests= computational coding which we practiced few times before the first test. 2 Tests & 1 Final Project. So many issues with the supercomputer & grades were put in about a week before Q drop. DO NOT TAKE HIM
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: It was very difficult to study for this class. The PowerPoint or lectures didn't help at all. Unless you had the key to his exams it was impossible to get higher than an 80 in the exam.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Dr. Polymenis is a very kind man if you can get ahold of him. His lectures are kind of impossible to follow and the powerpoints are 200+ slides. He does put them online so you can try to work through them yourself. His exams are the hardest I have experienced. He claims to have a test bank but they are mostly random MCAT and research questions.

Best professor and best class I've ever taken! Dr. Polymenis is so passionate about his subject and so knowledgable and helpful. His lectures are incredibly engaging and easy to follow. Do not listen to poor reviews below, his class is definitely easy and manageable. :)

Polymenis is a very sweet man, but not the best professor. He changed his exams, so they do not correspond with the old example questions. He does not use a textbook, give homework problems, or any example problems for his exams. It can be pretty confusing figuring out what type of questions/ what information you need to know for the exam.

His slides are next to impossible to understand if you don't go to class or if you're trying to look back over them before an exam. There's no textbook, so you really have no idea what's going to be on the test. The group projects are extra credit. There's no hw. Sit up front so you can hear, go over your notes after, and watch other lectures.
reviews.ratingTags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Group projects

reviews.comment: His slides are IMPOSSIBLE to read and make no sense. There are 300+ slides for every section. He encourages students to find a test bank that he uses to get his questions from. Since he doesn't write his own questions his tests are nothing like his slides. DO NOT TAKE.

Dr. Polymenis is honestly horrible. He is hard to understand because of his accent and the fact he talks fast. If you don't have the test bank and want to improve your grade, he tells you to go find the test bank or you're SOL. His averages are high only because people cheat. If you don't have connections to the bank, DO NOT TAKE!
reviews.ratingTags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Group projects

reviews.comment: Four test grades and a final. There are participation group projects but you don't get a lot of points for it. He reads off the slides which doesn't help you with the tests because they are specific. Really have to study the slides on your own, and even then you may not do well. Study what's highlighted in yellow if you happen to be stuck with him.

First off his powerpoints are 300 slides each. He is so quiet when he lectures good luck understanding him. His tests have absolutely NOTHING to do with the test, so even understanding the material won't help you pass the class.

Lectures are incredibly quiet. His accent is thick, but understandable if you sit close enough to be able to hear him. The lectures are very verbose and boring. The tests were pretty specific. He posts all slides online, I personally don't think it matters if you go to class if you have a firm understanding of the powerpoint.

Freshmen biochem/genetics majors don't pick their 101 class-if you get him you're in for an easy year! His lectures focus a lot on his research on aging, which is pretty interesting. This class requires virtually no effort up until the last month when you have a group presentation and video project, which are mainly participation grades. Great guy!

This professor is really laid back. There were about 3 short quizzes the semester and 2 group projects that were basically participation grades. You do have to read the scientific articles he posts on his website and go to class to be able to answer the questions on the quizzes.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: Dr. Polymenis teaches a lot of arbitrary items that you will be quizzed over. Be prepared. He stresses that this class is easy (which it is), but beware because you are only graded by a few items and missing a couple of points add up. You will have to give a group presentation and video at the end, which is mainly graded by participation.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough Grader--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Polymenis is alright, nothing bad but nothing too special either. From what I've heard of other BICH 101 classes though, he's definitely the easiest homework wise. Has a tendency to talk to some students as though they're not smart enough for him.
Dr. Polymenis is great!  Makes Biochem 2 EZPZ
